title: Flood-tolerant rice in eastern India

inventory.name: Swarna-Sub1 in surveyed rice farms
inventory.region: Sampled flood-prone districts of Odisha and West Bengal, India
inventory.claim: A post-harvest household survey documented growers in the 2015 kharif season. Cultivation was reported for 16.7% of sampled households in Odisha and 4.2% in West Bengal.
inventory.limit: Historical sample shares. A 2026 project report separately documents a Swarna Sub1 deployment footprint of 85 farmers, 10 villages and 34 ha in Rajkanika block. It gives no contemporary population-level uptake estimate or variety-specific harvest.

inventory.name: CR Dhan 801 drought-focused on-farm trial
inventory.claim: The extension team tested CR Dhan 801 against MTU-1001 and Jamuna on one farmer’s field in the 2023 kharif season, after official notification in 2019.
inventory.limit: A project field trial in a drought-prone area. The sources here provide no commercial sales or independent repeat-planting result.

trace: FR13A was selected from farmer-grown Dhalputtia at Cuttack. The original farmer landrace has no separate dated node in this proposal. The selection node is fr13a-rice-selection-cuttack.

Through the intervening line IR26702, FR13A supplied temporary-submergence tolerance to the IR49830 breeding family. The 1990–1991 trial tested IR49830-7-1-2-2. A canonical link from fr13a-rice-selection-cuttack to ir49830-rice-submergence-tolerance-los-banos captures the family ancestry.

The IR49830 family supplied submergence tolerance to Swarna-Sub1, with Swarna (MTU 7029) providing the cultivar background. Xu's 2006 paper and the Indian release dossier give the donor suffix -3. Septiningsih's 2009 account gives -2. The proposed canonical link to swarna-sub1-rice-odisha is scoped to the family.

Odisha released IR05F101 (IR82809-237) in 2009. The sibling Swarna-Sub1 line IR05F102 (IR82810-407) supplied the trait to CR Dhan 801. The proposed link connects the breeding programme's 2006 publication event to the CR Dhan 801 programme.
alternatives: Hasanta Sub1 and CR Dhan 1009 Sub1 were also deployed by UPSCALE in Rajkanika during the same 2026 season. The field update records their footprints without comparing recovery or yield.

The Singh et al. FAO case study reports limited uptake of Cambodia’s 1999 Popoul, an earlier IR49830-family release. The case study names a different line suffix from the later Swarna donor. Cambodian release records and cultivar-specific adoption evidence are still needed.
frontier: Obtain the Cuttack selection register and first seed release notices for FR13A, and the older IRRI transfer record naming the donor organization and accession.
Locate the April 2009 Odisha release papers and the separate central notification. For CR Dhan 801, obtain the release decision corresponding to the 2017 breeder-reported date.
Locate variety-specific post-flood harvest observations from Rajkanika and comparable post-2023 routine seed use or farm data for CR Dhan 801.
screen: Searched data/discoveries, data/sources and data/leads for Swarna, Sub1, FR13A, Dhalputtia and spelling variants, IR49830, and CR Dhan 801. No matching discovery or lead surfaced. Checked earlier rice-domestication, paddy irrigation and early-ripening Champa rice records for scope. They concern different achievements and no lineage to the modern entries was established. No register edits.
coverage: South Asia with an explicitly evidenced breeding contribution from the Philippines. Status search through 17 November 2026 found a September project update covering the August 2026 Odisha floods. No later cultivar-specific harvest or evidence that the newer lines displaced Swarna-Sub1 was located. Release, field trials, farmer-reported cultivation and project seed distribution are distinct events.
